text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп and Уиннинг Тикит board a
train to
test their mettle as "normies." All
they have to do
is behave like normal
passengers...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, they just can't do it. It's a
tough
world out there. But the test is not
for naught, for
Голд Шип comes to an
important realization:
dolphins must
never be mistaken for fish!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп hears a voice in her dreams
yet again.
Though it reminds her of
Мэдзиро МакКуин, there's
something
slightly different...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин's scent reminds Gold
Ship of the
tatami mats at her
grandfather's, but the voice in
her
dreams makes her think of dirty socks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
